id: GB-03 GSD re-entry with Git for Windows' drive-form toplevel
note: Sitting 4, P2. Under Git Bash git prints the worktree in drive form (C:/...); the GSD root finder refused any path not starting with /, so this checkout had no GSD root and the GSD re-entry, Was driving and Active driver commands got a stray ' --cwd <this checkout>'. The worktree, and a transcript cwd in drive form as Claude Code on Windows writes it (C:\...), are now read in their /c/ form (util::posix_form) before the compare. GSD work in another checkout still gets its --cwd. Seams: STORE_TEST_OS=msys, STORE_TEST_CYGDRIVE (C: reads as $TMP/cyg/c), and a git first on PATH that prints $TMP/cyg/c/... as C:/....

setup.script:
out=$(PATH=${PATH#*:} git "$@"); rc=$?
[ -n "$out" ] && printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed 's#/[^ ]*/cyg/c/#C:/#g'
exit $rc
